title: Programming Module
html:
This module owns playlists, programming groups, the draft programs of groups and screens, schedule rules, screen assignments and timelines under the programming design and ADR-0029. Read both before changing behavior.

  • schedule.ts is pure: it never reads a clock or the process time zone and takes IANA zone names explicitly. Keep conflict validation in local wall-clock minutes and zone resolution (gaps to the transition instant, repeated hours earlier for starts and later for ends, then the handoff clip) in the evaluator. Every behavior change updates the canonical fixtures, which the player (PJ-12) also runs; never change an expected result to make a test pass. zoneOffsets describes a zone with the same rules for screens, which resolve local times against it (player design); after changing the fixtures or zone handling, regenerate the player conformance file with pnpm -C apps/api conformance:write.
  • Human operations resolve access through the organizations CompanyAccessPort and take its lockForWrite before any programming row. Then lock in this order: screen rows (through the devices port's describe with a transaction), settings, groups, the per-company limits lock that counts takes before every count-and-insert, playlists. A resource the caller can see only partly, such as a group spanning a branch outside their reach, answers RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND; a screen's views show such a group as null and such a playlist by its ID only.
  • A rule or default may use a playlist only when every branch its program can reach is inside the playlist's scope; new media in a playlist must be selected through the media port's requireSelectable and fit the playlist's scope.
  • The module registers the playlist-draft media reference guard, the branch archive guard for explicit group spans and the devices move hook. They run inside the other module's transaction and must stay read-only, except the move hook, which updates the screen's settings in the move's transaction.
  • Assignments never edit programs. An assignment needs confirmUnpublished only when its destination has no publication, which the publications module answers through onPublicationFacts.
  • Every change writes its programming_audit_events row in the same transaction, with the branches it concerns; details hold names, counts, versions and IDs only.
